method: Full native initial and repair-1 emitted sequentially together; manual comparison of product contours, joins, shadows, lid response and fine detail outside intended text changes. No exact pixel preservation claim.
intended_changes: Remove upper-left header and lower-left stack; two-line name in cup interval; promise/spec beside compact state at right; operations lower-right; FOLN subordinate lower-left.

outside_text_comparison.region: Expanded cup and removed lid, upper right
outside_text_comparison.initial_observation: Open rim at about y138, cup base about y624; inner depth and repeated nested ribs visible; lid leaned at rear right.
outside_text_comparison.repair_observation: Open rim and base retain approximately the same location and size. Mouth, dark bowl, ribs and leaned lid remain structurally coherent.
outside_text_comparison.preserved: Same open state, silhouette, general diameter and soft left light.
outside_text_comparison.change_or_uncertainty: Lit front band's fine grain appears softer/less distinct than initial; exact surface detail is not demonstrably preserved. Lid response remains milky but small texture differences cannot be excluded.

outside_text_comparison.region: Collapsed cup and seated lid, lower left
outside_text_comparison.initial_observation: Top of lid near y518, bottom of folded body near y858; width roughly x109–620.
outside_text_comparison.repair_observation: Top of lid near y604, bottom of folded body near y944; width remains roughly x109–620. Folded cup moved downward approximately 85–90 native pixels.
outside_text_comparison.preserved: Shallow puck silhouette, nested green ribs, milky white seated lid and similar diameter.
outside_text_comparison.change_or_uncertainty: Unwanted position change outside typography; violates requested preservation of object location. The shadow moves down with the object. Rim/center fine detail also appears slightly softened.

outside_text_comparison.initial_observation: Pale gray ground with fine grain, soft shadows down/right, darker contact cores beneath cups.
outside_text_comparison.repair_observation: Pale ground and broad falloff remain, original header area is now clean ground. Folded cup's contact shadow is lower due its displacement. Background remains finely textured.
outside_text_comparison.preserved: Overall color/light direction and diffuse studio-ground impression.
outside_text_comparison.change_or_uncertainty: Ground at old folded-cup location is synthesized because object moved. No obvious new high-contrast repetitive grain was observed, but the ground is not pixel-identical and broad small-texture preservation is uncertain.

physical_or_material_regressions_observe: Collapsed cup/lid/shadow shifted downward by approximately 85–90 pixels.
Fine detail on lit silicone and seated lid appears softened relative to initial; cannot certify exact material-detail retention.
not_observed: No extra object, handle, label, cutaway, new effect, obvious all-over texture amplification, broken rim or melted join found.
preservation_verdict: Key photographic states/light/contours retained visually; position and fine-detail preservation are partial. Local edit is not exact photographic preservation.
